why: Compare each row's first box with the other two: in one box the first arrow is turned around, in the other box the second arrow is turned around. Row 3 starts with down-up; the third box down-down turns the second arrow, so the middle box must turn the first arrow: up-up. That is option 1.
trick: Look at which arrow changes in each box of a full row, then copy that change.
